title: seed-harness-console
responsibility: Builds the fixed synthetic Git history the console browser acceptance inspects.

outputs.name: seedHarnessConsole
outputs.description: Resolves after the synthetic Git history, indexed reports, scale data and metadata are written to the current browser run’s console fixture directory.

errors.name: E2eRootNotSetError
errors.description: The explicit call rejects before seeding if HARNESS_E2E_ROOT is missing. Importing the module does not require a browser run.
